q1_label_audit.headline: the relabel changes the damping-vs-'native' level by +46% at tau570 (mean 2115 -> 3087 veh-s) and flips its sign in 10-24% of world-tau pairs (tau-dependent); CAL tau570 means: true damping-vs-native +5184.8 vs old +3110.6, 10/14 signs agree

q2_rescore.headline: sign skill survives (CAL 0.71-0.86 by tau; tau570 0.857 [0.714, 1.000]); value skill does not: CRPS worse than zero at short tau (strict <= 120, detector <= 60) and worse than the TRAIN-cell-mean TRUE-contrast baseline at every tau in both variants; one-sided under-prediction bias because the models were fitted to damping-vs-SWITCHING gaps that are 1.5-3x smaller than the TRUE gaps

physical_results.q3_inventory: 5 report families CORRECTED (v0.2_run1, v0.3_hybrid, v0.3.1_hybrid_deployable, v0.3.1_selected_deployable(+r2,x1,x2), v0.3.2_strict, v0.3.2_detector section-3 contrasts), A2_ERRATUM + REPORT_PA2G_EVAL_A stand (policy-name-independent / already caveated + superseded), held C2L1 WITHDRAWN (never run, invalid truth), archived STAGE1C2_RESULTS has no such claim, PL-02a listed out of scope; full table in REPORT_PB_RESCORE1.md section 3

integrity_limitations: Single realisation per arm and world: contrasts are exact per root (A2 erratum H1), not expectations over stochasticity.
10 s window offset between the damping arm (t0) and the branch arms (t0+10 s), identical to all earlier reports.
CRPS of dY uses the 7 x 7 independent quantile-level pairing of the two policy-conditioned predictive distributions (49 equally-likely differences), an approximation documented in the report.
CAL is a second read for v0.3.2 (disclosed, report-only; no selection or calibration follows). TRAIN results are in-sample-trained.

Q2 evaluates the shipped models off their training distribution (TRUE-native gaps are larger than anything in the training labels); the bias is a statement about the shipped models, not about retrained ones.
Chunk-1 has no truearms references and is out of scope (per registration).

The label root copies base/native labels+td from the frozen v0.3.2 root rather than rebuilding them; parity of the same code path with the v0.3.2 labels is pinned by an exact-match test on one TRAIN damping source.
what_must_not_be_inferred: That the v0.3.2 models are useless for planning: sign direction survives at useful levels; the re-scored quantity is the damping-vs-native contrast, not the delay-level heads.
That a retrained/relabelled contrast model would or would not carry value skill: no model was trained or selected here.
Any wall or controller efficacy claim: this analysis characterizes predictors and labels only.
